lines.en: Sara looks at me in silence for a moment as Haruka and Maki fall deeper into each other’s eyes.
lines.zh: Sara沉默地看了我一会儿，而遥和Maki则越陷越深地望着彼此的眼睛。

lines.en: scene milfparty26
